# CVEs osv-check.sh reports but that do not affect our builds, one per line
# with the reason. Fixed ones go once the release we use includes the fix.

# Fixed by deps/patches (macOS, Linux, Windows) and by the same patches in
# our pkgsrc packages (IRIX):
CVE-2026-50811 FreeType 2.14.3: upstream 5a280ec, deps/patches/freetype-2.14.3
CVE-2026-95512 FreeType 2.14.3: upstream f3ca71c, deps/patches/freetype-2.14.3
CVE-2026-76844 zlib 1.3.2: upstream df84af2, deps/patches/zlib-1.3.2 (macOS and Linux use the system's zlib)
